description: Ask the Starcovery team to open payouts for the caller's organization, so it can receive creator pay. The team then sends an invite that asks for the bank details and tax documents. Only organization owners and admins may call it, and the organization needs a verified handle claim first; otherwise it returns a tool error naming the reason. Returns the payout account state. Needs a credential.
name: request_payout_account_setup
title: Request payout setup
